packet_contract_model.dtx_model: deterministic mean-absolute-energy gate; omit drops silent source frames, cn emits one bounded comfort-noise packet per silent run
packet_contract_model.fec_model: synthetic previous-frame copy embedded in the next contiguous audio packet; one packet deep; not Opus LBRR
packet_contract_model.frame_encoding: first-order sample delta, zigzag signed mapping, 7-bit little-endian varint; each frame length-prefixed with two big-endian bytes
packet_contract_model.limitations: Synthetic structural model only. Payload sizes, recovery depth and comfort-noise levels do not describe Opus, RFC 6716, SILK, CELT, Opus 1.4/1.5/1.6 or any vendor implementation.
packet_contract_model.purpose: Exercise a receive/transmit packet contract that is distinct from PCM so packetization, redundancy, DTX and comfort-noise accounting can be validated fail-closed without a codec runtime.

transmit_packet.seq: non-negative integer, contiguous from zero within a trace
